summary: This batch reports seven building collapses and four extensively damaged structures across Chinatown and the Financial District, with 10 people reported trapped across 38 Hotaling Pl, 840 California St, 450 Grant Ave, and Sacramento/Sansome. Major hazards include an active fire in the collapsed building at 53 Waverly Pl and a gas leak at 515-523 Broadway.
